metadata.title: Joint constraints on the Galactic dark matter halo and Galactic Centre from hypervelocity stars

notes: No individually identifiable star is named in the supplied material. T:p5-b5 states that the statistical comparison uses 21 unbound HVSs selected from Brown et al. (2014) with velocity >275 km s−1, masses 2.5–4 M⊙, and Galactocentric distances 50–120 kpc, but neither that passage nor the figures (I:p5-b0 and I:p7-b0) supplies per-star names or catalog identifiers. The aggregate 21-star sample therefore cannot be expanded into individual star entries under the rules.
